# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/hcloud
# args: 
Manage Firewalls

Usage:
  hcloud firewall [command]

Aliases:
  firewall, firewalls

General:
  add-label            Add a label to a Firewall
  create               Create a Firewall
  delete               Delete a Firewall
  describe             Describe a Firewall
  list                 List Firewalls
  remove-label         Remove a label from a Firewall
  update               Update a Firewall

Rules:
  add-rule             Add a single rule to a firewall
  delete-rule          Delete a single rule from a Firewall
  replace-rules        Replaces all rules from a Firewall from a file

Resources:
  apply-to-resource    Applies a Firewall to a single resource
  remove-from-resource Removes a Firewall from a single resource

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for firewall

Global Flags:
      --config string              Config file path (default "~/.config/hcloud/cli.toml")
      --context string             Currently active context
      --debug                      Enable debug output
      --debug-file string          File to write debug output to
      --endpoint string            Hetzner Cloud API endpoint (default "https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1")
      --hetzner-endpoint string    Hetzner API endpoint (default "https://api.hetzner.com/v1")
      --http-timeout duration      Timeout for HTTP requests (default 0 = no timeout)
      --no-experimental-warnings   If true, experimental warnings are not shown
      --poll-interval duration     Interval at which to poll information, for example action progress (default 500ms)
      --quiet                      If true, only print error messages

Use "hcloud firewall [command] --help" for more information about a command.
